title: do / make / have / take Collocations
grammarNote:
DO, MAKE, HAVE, TAKE — четыре самых сложных глагола. Один русский "делать" = несколько английских.

🔵 DO — деятельность, задачи, обязанности:
do homework · do the washing · do exercise · do research · do your best

🟡 MAKE — создание, производство, результат:
make a cake · make a mistake · make progress · make a decision
make money · make a noise · make a phone call · make an effort

🟢 HAVE — обладание, принятие пищи, опыт:
have breakfast/lunch/dinner · have a shower · have a rest · have fun
have a conversation · have time · have a meeting · have an idea

🔴 TAKE — взятие, использование, выбор:
take a photo · take a seat · take a bus/taxi · take a break
take notes · take an exam · take medicine · take a risk

⚠️ Частые ошибки:
❌ "Do a photo" → ✅ "Take a photo"
❌ "Make homework" → ✅ "Do homework"
❌ "Do a mistake" → ✅ "Make a mistake"
❌ "Make a shower" → ✅ "Have a shower"

grammarTip:
Запомни через ассоциации:

DO = "выполнять задачи": do homework · do research · do exercise · do cleaning
MAKE = "создавать / производить": make a cake · make a mistake · make a decision
HAVE = "испытывать / употреблять": have fun · have a shower · have lunch
TAKE = "брать / использовать": take a photo · take a break · take an exam

🎯 Быстрый тест:
___ a suggestion? → make
___ the ironing? → do
___ a nap? → have
___ the stairs? → take
